plansIntro: Choose a project to manage its plan, stages, work items and progress images.
templatesIntro: Maintain reusable stage and item templates. Existing project plans keep their own copies.
loadFailed: Planning data could not be loaded
saved: Saved. The latest server data is shown.
conflict: This action conflicts with the current data. Review the refreshed state and your draft before trying again.
uncertain: The result could not be confirmed. Check the latest data before making another change; the action will not be sent again.
discardDescription: Continuing discards all unsaved drafts on this page, including image selections.
wait: Wait for the current action and its outcome check to finish.
dateHint: Required. Include the time and UTC offset, for example 2026-12-01T09:00:00+02:00.
confirmedHint: Optional unless Completed. Include the time and UTC offset, for example 2026-12-01T09:00:00+02:00.
dateInvalid: Enter a valid date, time and UTC offset.
noPlan: This project has no time plan yet.
deletePlanDescription: Permanently delete this plan, all its stages, work items and progress images? Unsaved drafts in this hierarchy will also be discarded.
chooseStage: Select a stage to manage its items.
deleteStageDescription: Permanently delete this stage, its work items and images? Unsaved drafts in this stage will also be discarded.
templateSnapshot: The server will create a separate stage with these template items. Enter the project dates for each item.
inactiveSource: This template or one of its assigned items is inactive. Choose another template or update its sources first.
sourceChanged: The template's assigned items changed. Your dates have been kept. Reset these dates to start from the current template.
emptyTemplate: This template has no assigned items. The new stage will be empty.
deleteItemDescription: Permanently delete this work item and all its images? Its unsaved drafts will also be discarded.
statusHint: Any of the three statuses may be selected. Completed requires an explicit confirmation date. Other items and stages are not completed automatically.
imageUnavailable: This image was removed. Its description draft remains here until you leave this item; it cannot be saved to the removed image.
uploadHint: Choose one JPEG, PNG or WebP image, up to 5 MiB. Its description is optional.
fileSize: Choose a non-empty image no larger than 5 MiB.
fileType: Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP file with a matching file extension.
uploadRejected: Check the image file and description. Your selection has been kept.
deleteImageDescription: Permanently delete this progress image and its description?
activationDescription: Change this template's availability for future plans? Existing project stages and items keep their current values.
deleteTemplateDescription: Permanently delete this template and its template assignments? Existing project plans keep their separate stages and items.
missingTemplate: This template is unavailable. Choose another result or create a new template.
templateDeleted: The template was deleted. Choose another result or create a new template.
assignmentHint: Choose up to 100 distinct item templates and arrange their order. Inactive items can remain assigned, but the stage cannot be applied until all its sources are active.
duplicateAssignment: This item template is already assigned.
replaceAssignments: Replace all assigned item templates with this ordered selection? Existing project plans are unchanged.
